feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
entry.summary: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

entry.title: Meth is a key driver in Fiji's fast-growing HIV epidemic: 1 in 60 adults are affected
entry.summary: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

entry.title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions
entry.summary: The battle over AI's promise and perils is not a clash between two opposing sides, but a debate among a range of competing voices and ideologies. Here is a guide to who's who in that debate.

entry.title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?
entry.summary: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs. Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.

entry.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entry.summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entry.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.

entry.title: Roads flood in New Jersey, inundate some homes, as first major signs of nor'easter take shape
entry.summary: Thousands are without power on the U.S. East Coast, while roads are flooding in some coastal New Jersey communities.

entry.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
entry.summary: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

entry.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
entry.summary: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

entry.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
entry.summary: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.
